run_plot_successes: run the script to plot goal and collide rates from numpy arrays as PNG images
run_plot_successes_by_vehicles: run the script to generate plots of success rates as a function of vehicle count
run_plot_successes_by_distance: run the script to generate plots of success rates as a function of start distance
run_plot_successes_save_png: run the script to save goal rate and collide rate plots as numbered PNG files
run_plot_successes_load_npy: run the script to load success_by_veh_number.npy and success_by_dist.npy and plot results
